REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
TUESDAY - OCTOBER 14, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to economic_development@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Economic Development Commission Meeting
October 14, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Kenneth Chiang
  Commissioner Aris Tagle
  Vice Chair Grace Hu
  Chair Alfred Reyes Jr.

PRESENT:  Senior Assistant City Manager Kristin Aguila
  Theater Executive Director Jeff Thielke
  Advance Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda
  Communications Manager Scott Harvey
  Marketing Administrator Glenn Arnade

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Tagle.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Economic Development Commission were declared present,
  except Commissioner Hews, who was noted absent and excused by a majority
  consensus of the Economic Development Commission.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Public comment was provided by Cerritos Chamber of Commerce
  Member Dr. Etelvina Jurado, providing an update on upcoming activities for the
  Chamber of Commerce. Public comment was provided by a Cerritos resident
  regarding funding provided to the Cerritos Chambers of Commerce. Public comment
  was provided by Cerritos resident Sam Desai made comments on the importance of
  being dedicated to the City of Cerritos and Commissioner responsibilities. Seeing and
  hearing no one else wishing to address the Economic Development Commission,
  Chair Reyes closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Tuesday, September 9, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development Commission Regular
  Meeting Minutes.
City of Cerritos  October 14, 2025
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Hu, and seconded by Commissioner Ching, to
  approve the Tuesday, September 9, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Economic Development
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chiang, Tagle, Hu, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Hews
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  New and Old Business

6A.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding the programs and
  services provided by the Southeast Los Angeles County Workforce Development
  Board (SELACO WDB).

  A brief introduction was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana
  Miranda. A verbal report was given by SELACO WDB Executive Director Yolanda
  Castro who provided a presentation giving an overview of SELECO WDB’s service
  area and eight (8) cities served. Ms. Castro continued with additional information
  on job search resources provided to individuals seeking jobs, including training,
  job placement, and connection to employers. Ms. Castro provided further
  information about services provided to employees, including those in Cerritos.

  Discussion continued with the Commission regarding community partnerships,
  no-fee services, on-the-job training, measurable metrics, and artificial
  intelligence.

6B.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding economic
  development updates in the City of Cerritos, including grand opening and re-
  opening events, building permit activity, and on-going development projects.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed, providing details about recent business
  openings, current and on-going development, and permit activity in the City of
  Cerritos. Mrs. Miranda continued with an overview of development activities
  citywide.

  Chair Reyes opened public comment. Comments were received regarding he
  promotion of SELACO WDB and Chamber of Commerce activities. Discussion
  continued with the Commission related to specific projects, housing, and business
  attraction statistics. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Reyes declared the public
  hearing closed.

6C.  Review and consideration of an informational report regarding the City’s
  Economic Development webpage features and marketing initiatives.

  A staff report was given by Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda and
  Marketing Administrator Glenn Arnade. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed,
  providing details about the City’s Economic Development webpage features,
  marketing initiatives, and highlighting the City of Cerritos’ marketing initiatives. The
  presentation provided an overview of the resources available to business and
City of Cerritos  October 14, 2025
Economic Development Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   investors in collaboration with the City’s marketing initiatives to strengthen economic
  development in Cerritos and improve community communication. Mr. Arnade
  provided details about current and future City marketing strategies that align with
  Strategic Plan Goals #4 and #7. The presentation concluded with a short video of
  highlighting the recent grand opening of Chubby Cattle.

  Chair Reyes opened public comment. Seeing and hearing no speakers, Chair Reyes
  declared the public hearing closed.

7.  Reports

7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  Economic Development Manager Kiana Miranda informed the Commission that the
  next Economic Development Commission meeting will be a special meeting held on
  Wednesday, November 12, 2025 in observance of the Veteran’s Day holiday.

7B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Tagle and Chair Reyes.

8.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:40 p.m.

  /s/Kiana Miranda
